source: Real guest reviews from the 24/7 Clinic Google and Facebook pages, sent by the owner as screenshots on 2026-11-18. Quoted exactly; the ellipsis marks words left out. Marija Neskovic is shown in her original Serbian.

reviews.name: Markus Sutor
reviews.text: I can wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Mustafa and his team! From the very first meeting, I was treated with great kindness, professionalism, and expertise.

reviews.name: Marija Spasic
reviews.text: Truly exceptional medical care, compassion, and dedication. Highly recommended to anyone in need of medical assistance in Hurghada!

reviews.name: Barbara Neveians
reviews.text: A very professional doctor who truly knows his field. … With this doctor, you feel that you are in good hands.

reviews.name: Mila Amethyst Nox
reviews.text: The doctor and the technician, Karim, are the most wonderful people ever! … I would recommend them 1000/10.

reviews.name: Marija Neskovic
reviews.text: Preporuka za sve srpske turiste, brzi su, temeljni, rade 24/7. … Inace za kliniku i doktore sve pohvale!
